title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Green City, Shitet Ambient Komercial Ideal Per Zyra Ose Dyqan!!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Green City, Shitet Ambient Komercial Ideal Per Zyra Ose Dyqan!!! Ambjenti ndodhet ne katin perdhe te nje pallati te ri, ndërtim i vitit 2020. Siperfaqe totale e ambientit eshte 44m² dhe neto 43.14m². Hapësira përbëhet nga një shkallë e vogël, tre dritare të mëdha dhe një tualet i pajisur me lavaman, tualet dhe një aspirator. Kompleksi ku ndodhet eshte nga komplekset me te mira te viteve te fundit me shume hapesira te perbashketa, pishina, etj. Disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: At Green City Complex, Ideal Commercial Space For Office Or Shop!!
description_en: At Green City Complex, Ideal Commercial Space For Office Or Shop!!! The premises is located on the ground floor of a new building, built in 2020. The total area of ​​the premises is 44m² and net 43.14m². The space consists of a small staircase, three large windows and a bathroom equipped with a sink, toilet and an extractor. The complex where it is located is one of the best complexes of recent years with many common spaces, swimming pools, etc. Has regular mortgage documentation.
